display_name: Nana Sahib (with Mowbray Thomson & Colonel Neill ensemble)
one_line: Three central figures at Kanpur in June–July 1857: Nana Sahib, British survivor Mowbray Thomson, and Colonel James George Neill.

appearance.age_look: Nana Sahib appears mid-30s, lean but dignified; Thomson appears late-20s, wiry; Neill appears mid-40s, broad-shouldered and imposing.
appearance.face: Nana Sahib has an oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache, calm yet intense gaze; Thomson has a narrow fair face, straight nose, short sideburns, alert blue eyes; Neill has a square ruddy face, strong jaw, heavy moustache, stern grey-blue eyes, default expressions focused and serious.
appearance.hair: Nana Sahib’s hair is black, straight, medium length, mostly hidden under a red silk Maratha-style pagri turban with a subtle gold border; Thomson’s hair is short, light brown, parted to the side, regulation British officer style with tidy sideburns; Neill’s hair is dark brown greying at the temples, cut short with a severe side part, no headwear.
appearance.costume: Nana Sahib wears a long off-white cotton angarkha reaching mid-calf with side ties, over cream churidar trousers; a deep maroon silk patka sash with thin gold edge wraps his waist and hangs on his left side; he has a fitted sleeveless dark green waistcoat with simple gold piping, brown leather mojari shoes, and minimal jewellery: a single gold signet ring and a slim gold chain barely visible at the neck. Mowbray Thomson wears 1850s British officer undress: a dark navy-blue single-breasted tunic with modest stand collar and brass buttons, light khaki-brown trousers slightly tucked into mid-calf black leather boots, a simple brown leather belt, and no epaulettes or cloak, keeping him practical and campaign-worn. Colonel Neill wears a full British line officer field uniform: scarlet red tunic with dark blue facings, standing collar with subtle gold edging, plain gold shoulder straps, dark blue trousers with a narrow red side stripe, polished black leather belt with brass buckle, and knee-high black riding boots; he does not wear a hat in the default design, emphasizing his stern profile.
appearance.signature: Nana Sahib carries a single sheathed talwar in a brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings at his left hip, one hand often resting lightly on the hilt; Thomson carries a plain Pattern 1822–style British infantry officer’s sword in its steel scabbard held in his left hand; Neill holds a polished cavalry sabre unsheathed in his right hand, blade angled down, with his scabbard hanging from a black leather sword belt.

ref_desc: Nana Sahib has a medium-brown oval face, red turban, off-white angarkha with maroon sash and dark green waistcoat, bearing a sheathed talwar; beside him Thomson in navy tunic and khaki trousers with a plain sword, and Neill in scarlet uniform with sabre, using off-white, maroon, dark green, navy and scarlet tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing three fixed characters from Kanpur, June–July 1857: Nana Sahib front and center, with a medium-brown oval face, calm intense eyes, neat moustache, and black hair under a red silk Maratha-style turban; he wears an off-white cotton angarkha over cream churidar trousers, a deep maroon sash at his waist, a dark green sleeveless waistcoat with simple gold piping, brown mojari shoes, and carries a sheathed talwar at his left hip. On his right, draw Mowbray Thomson with a narrow fair face, short light brown hair parted to the side, alert blue eyes, in a dark navy British officer tunic with brass buttons, light khaki-brown trousers, brown leather belt, and mid-calf black boots, holding a plain infantry officer’s sword in its steel scabbard. On Nana Sahib’s left, draw Colonel Neill with a square ruddy face, strong jaw, heavy moustache, short dark brown hair greying at the temples, stern grey-blue eyes, in a scarlet red British officer tunic with dark blue facings, thin gold trim on collar and shoulder straps, dark blue trousers with a narrow red stripe, and knee-high black riding boots, gripping an unsheathed cavalry sabre angled down. Use off-white, maroon, dark green, navy blue, and scarlet red as the dominant colours, and present all three head-to-toe in clear, consistent costumes with their weapons visible.
